## What happened?

Describe the expected behavior and the actual result. Distinguish a transport error from an unverified guest outcome.

## Minimal reproduction

Prefer a synthetic fixture or a disposable guest. Include the VM Bridge version, Windows/VMware version, guest OS, CLI or MCP client, and sanitized error category.

## Validation

What did you check? Can it be reproduced without changing an active VM or taking over the host desktop?

## Privacy check

Remove passwords, tokens, usernames/home paths, real VM inventory, private hostnames/IPs, screenshots and production state before posting. Do not attach installed configuration, databases or keys.
